applicabilityBasis.summary: srUSD is Reservoir's yield-accruing savings position minted from rUSD. The public savings documentation describes governance-set interest accruing daily, while reserve documentation describes conversion into rUSD subject to PSM liquidity. The token represents a value-accruing protocol position rather than a fixed-monetary-value payment or settlement instrument.

genius.notes: srUSD is assessed independently from base rUSD as a yield-accruing savings position. This exclusion is a research application of the GENIUS payment-stablecoin definition, not a regulator decision on the named token or an exemption for the underlying rUSD. The legal token issuer is not identified in the opened protocol documents; Reservoir Foundation and Fortunafi Capital Management LLC are not substituted as issuer. Public protocol reserve disclosures and smart-contract audits do not establish independent monthly stablecoin reserve attestations. No official payment-stablecoin authorization is asserted.
